sections.en: And once judgment is meted out to the wicked, the transgressors, i.e., the heretics and sectarians, will cease to be. Consequently, the next blessing is that of the heretics, and one includes evildoers with them, as it is stated: “And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the Lord shall cease to be” (Isaiah 1:28). The “transgressors and sinners” are the evildoers, and “they that forsake the Lord” are the heretics.
sections.he: וְכֵיוָן שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה דִּין מִן הָרְשָׁעִים — כָּלוּ הַפּוֹשְׁעִים, וְכוֹלֵל זֵדִים עִמָּהֶם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְשֶׁבֶר פּוֹשְׁעִים וְחַטָּאִים יַחְדָּיו (יִכְלוּ)״.

en:
רוּם, רִים (Biblical Hebrew) [to swing,] to be high, lifted up; to rise. Pirkei Avot Zar. 24ᵇ רוֹמִי רומי השיטה Arukh (ed. רוני) rise, rise, acacia (holy ark)!; Breishit Rabbah section (Parashah) 54 רומי השטה.

Hifil - הרִים
1) to lift up, raise. Shir HaShirim Rabbah to III, 4 (reference. to Psalms LXXV, 8) ישפיל … ויָרִים לכרש וכ׳ he shall lower Belshazzar, and lift up Cyrus and Darius; Yalkut Psalms 812 אני הוא משפיל ומֵרִים I lower and raise; מלכות … מרים he lays low one empire and raises another empire &c.; and e.

—2) to take off, remove. Ruth Rabbah to I, 17 (reference. to Ezekiel XXI, 31) הסר … והָרִים העטרה וכ׳ remove the bonnet from our teachers, and take the crown off the nations; and e.

Hof. - הוּרָם to be taken off, especially to be separated as an offering, priest’s share &c.; to be consecrated. Hallah II, 8 שלא הוּרְמָה חלתה (not הורם), see חַלָּה. Sifré Bamidbar 110 (reference. to Bamidbar IV, 20) את שמוּרָם קודש וכ׳ that which is separated is to be sacred, and the remainder secular, but (no Ḥallah is to be taken,) when both would be sacred. Zevachim V, 6 המורם מהם וכ׳ the same rules apply to what is taken off them for the priest; and from

Polel. - רוֹמֵם to lift up, elevate. Midrash Tanḥuma Matt. 6; Bamidabar Rabbah section (Parashah) 22, end (reference. to Bamidbar XXXI, 9 and XXXII, 1) הא שהשפיל … ור׳ וכ׳ here you see that the Lord lowered the Midianites, and raised the Israelites. Ib. (reference. to I Samuel II, 7) אף … מְרוֹמֵם את זה in the anger which he brings to bear on one, he raises the other. Pesikta d'Rav Kahana R. section (Parashah) 10 (reference. to Psalms LXXV, 8) משפיל לכל … ומרומם וכ׳ he lowered every one that had part in the worship of the golden calf, and elevated every one that had no part &c. Ib. ועכשיו … אף כך רוֹמֵם ראשם and now that thou hast lifted up my head, lift thou up their head likewise; לך ר׳ ראשם go and lift up their heads (announce to them the divine pardon). Ib. (reference. to Shemot XXX, 12) כל מה שאתה יכול לרוֹמֵם … רוֹמְמָהּ שבאילו לי אתה מְרוֹמֵם (not רומם) in whatever way thou canst elevate that nation elevate it, for by this thou elevatest me. Shemot Rabbah section (Parashah) 25 ורִימְּמָן הקב"ה וכ׳ (from רָמַם) and the Lord raised them above all; and from

Hithpol. - הִתְרוֹמֵם, , Nithpol. נִתְרוֹמֵם to be lifted up; to pride one’s self. Yerushalmi Berakhot IX, 14ᵃ top יתגדל … ויתברך ויִתְרוֹמַם שמך וכ׳ thy Name be magnified … and blessed and lifted up (praised) for &c.; Yerushalmi Taanit I, 64ᵃ top; Breishit Rabbah section (Parashah) 13. Megillah 17ᵇ כיון … מִתְרוֹמֶמֶת קרן וכ׳ when the transgressors cease to exist, the horn of the righteous will be uplifted. Bamidabar Rabbah section (Parashah) 22; Midrash Tanḥuma Matt. 6, and e. אין אדם מִתְרוֹמֵם, see רוֹמֵמוּת. Midrash Tanḥuma Mick. 3 ונִתְרוֹמְמוּ and they were raised (to power); and e.—[Yalkut Breishit 79 מתרוממות, read: מְתַמְּרִין, see תָּמַר.]

sections.en: And once the heretics cease to be, the horn, i.e., the glory, of the righteous will be exalted, as it is written: “All the horns of the wicked will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted” (Psalms 75:11). Therefore, after the blessing of the heretics, one says the blessing about the righteous. And he includes the righteous converts along with the righteous, as it is stated: “You shall rise up before the hoary head, and honor the face of the elder” (Leviticus 19:32), and adjacent to this it is stated: “And if a stranger sojourns with you” (Leviticus 19:33). An “elder” is one with Torah wisdom and a “stranger” is one who has converted to Judaism.
sections.he: וְכֵיוָן שֶׁכָּלוּ הַפּוֹשְׁעִים — מִתְרוֹמֶמֶת קֶרֶן צַדִּיקִים, דִּכְתִיב: ״וְכׇל קַרְנֵי רְשָׁעִים אֲגַדֵּעַ תְּרוֹמַמְנָה קַרְנוֹת צַדִּיק״. וְכוֹלֵל גֵּירֵי הַצֶּדֶק עִם הַצַּדִּיקִים, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״מִפְּנֵי שֵׂיבָה תָּקוּם וְהָדַרְתָּ פְּנֵי זָקֵן״ — וּסְמִיךְ לֵיהּ: ״וְכִי יָגוּר אִתְּכֶם גֵּר״.

comments.he: והיכן מתרוממת קרנם של צדיקים? בירושלים, שנאמר: "שאלו שלום ירושלים ישליו אהביך" (תהלים קכב, ו) לכן סמכו את ברכת "בונה ירושלים" לברכת "על הצדיקים".

comments.he: שַׁ֭אֲלוּ שְׁל֣וֹם יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם יִ֝שְׁלָ֗יוּ אֹהֲבָֽיִךְ׃

sections.en: And where will the horns of the righteous be exalted? In Jerusalem, as it is stated: “Pray for the peace of Jerusalem; they who love you shall prosper” (Psalms 122:6). “They who love you” are the righteous. Therefore, the blessing of the rebuilding of Jerusalem is placed after the blessing of the righteous.
sections.he: וְהֵיכָן מִתְרוֹמֶמֶת קַרְנָם — בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״שַׁאֲלוּ שְׁלוֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָם יִשְׁלָיוּ אוֹהֲבָיִךְ״.
